extraction: Unmodified VizieR ASU-TSV response for a SINGLE named table. Validated: not HTML, no '#INFO Error=' line, catalogue id echoed, row count asserted. NOTE: querying the parent catalogue J/ApJ/823/157 returns table4 and table5 CONCATENATED with different column sets, which cannot be represented by one column list; the tables are therefore fetched separately.
measurement_or_model: MEASUREMENT. Spectroscopic heliocentric radial velocities and [Fe/H]. The 'LOS' flag records the authors' membership assignment (a selection, not a dynamical model).
note: Ishigaki et al. 2016, ApJ 823, 157, Table 5: stars in the Keck/DEIMOS fields selected by CMD, [Fe/H] and proper-motion criteria, with heliocentric radial velocities HRV and errors.
